scope: Built OpenConductor frontend in Chromium on Reason Cloud, with invented IPC data; no real CLI, credentials or settings files.

baseline.result: Existing default-clear and rejection/recovery checks passed. The new check timed out after 3000ms waiting for a post-persistence Reason status request.

checks: three rapid default clears survive an older response and persist together
rejected save rolls back and does not poison the next save
executable persistence refreshes Reason status and obsolete results are ignored
preset selection, custom command editing and deletion round-trip through the settings UI
fixed.build: npm run build passed, including TypeScript

limits: The test delays actual frontend IPC calls but does not run the native Tauri backend.
This does not prove real Reason CLI authentication or native Mac rendering.
No new visual styling is introduced by the status-refresh correction.
